Chapter 4: Professional Skill and Career Development

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Engineering Practice and Legal Framework
questions.text: Explain the Code of Ethics for Professional Engineers prescribed by the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC). Discuss ethical obligations towards the society, client, employer, profession, and fellow engineers. Explain Conflict of Interest with practical construction engineering examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Engineering Practice and Legal Framework
questions.text: Explain Professional Liability and Negligence in civil engineering design and supervision. What is Tort Liability and Contractual Liability? Explain Whistleblowing and ethical dilemmas when safety standards are compromised.

Explain the Social Impact Assessment (SIA) process for major infrastructure projects (Highways, Hydropower, Airports). Explain Land Acquisition, Compensation, Resettlement and Rehabilitation (R&R) frameworks, and Public Hearing mechanisms.

Explain the Nepal Environment Protection Act and Rules. Differentiate between Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) and Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). Explain Environmental Management Plan (EMP) and UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11, 13).

Explain Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) mainstreaming in infrastructure development projects. Discuss the Nepal Labor Act provisions regarding occupational health and safety, minimum wages, equal remuneration, and child labor prohibition.
